name: Banana Bunchy Top Disease
description: A severe viral disease that causes characteristic bunchy-top appearance in bananas. It is transmitted by the banana aphid and through infected planting material, causing significant yield losses.
symptoms: Dark green streaks or Morse code-like marks on petioles
Leaves becoming narrow, erect, and brittle
Leaves forming a rosette or bunchy appearance at stem apex
Plants failing to produce fruit bunches
causes: Use of infected suckers for planting
Infected volunteer plants near the field
seasonality: Aphid population peaks during wet season
treatments: Remove and destroy entire infected plant including corm
Inject herbicide into pseudostem to kill corm before removal
Control aphid vectors with systemic insecticides or neem oil
prevention: Plant certified virus-free tissue culture banana plants
Regular field scouting and removal of infected plants
Control banana aphids using neem-based sprays
Remove wild banana plants that may harbor the virus
